title.value: Applications of blockchain and artificial intelligence technologies for enabling prosumers in smart grids: A review
title.justification: The extracted title from the paper directly represents the paper's theme and focus.
title.quote: Applications of blockchain and artificial intelligence technologies for enabling prosumers in smart grids: A review

extractions.description: The paper explores the integration of blockchain and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies in smart grids to support prosumers—individuals who both consume and produce energy. It reviews policy designs for carbon pricing and discusses new energy market structures facilitated by blockchain technologies. The paper also explores the use of AI for optimizing power system operations, highlighting how these digital technologies can help in achieving net-zero emissions by enhancing energy efficiency, facilitating decentralized energy trading, and promoting the engagement of prosumers in energy markets.
